description: This file implements a broadcast channel consumer extension for Orleans, including an interface for handling stream errors and published items, as well as a class that manages callbacks for specific streams with concurrency control and subscription management.

classes.name: IBroadcastChannelConsumerExtension
classes.description: Interface defining methods for handling errors and published messages in the broadcast channel.

classes.name: BroadcastChannelConsumerExtension
classes.description: Implements the consumer extension that manages callbacks for broadcast channel streams, including attaching handlers and handling subscription notifications.

classes.name: Callback<T>
classes.description: A generic callback handler that invokes the provided functions on published items or errors, with type checking.

methods.name: OnError
methods.description: Handles stream errors by invoking appropriate callback.

methods.name: OnPublished
methods.description: Handles published items on a stream by invoking the callback.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Attaches a handler for 'onPublished' and 'onError' events to a specific stream.

methods.name: GetStreamCallback
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a callback for a given stream ID, with concurrency control and subscription notification.

methods.name: BroadcastChannelConsumerExtension (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes the extension with a grain context accessor and verifies subscription observer implementation.
